title: Moesha
description:
S4 E17 — Girl’s Night In
At a slumber party, Moesha and her friends reminisce (with clips from past episodes) about the past four years together.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E18 — It Takes Two
Kim’s mother, Nikki, is re-entering a journey she started 18 years ago. With Dee’s help, she will be completing her education to receive a high school diploma.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E19 — Had To Be You
An old boyfriend of Andell’s comes back into her life and proposes to her.  Moesha tries to keep Andell and Moesha’s Uncle Bernie together before it’s too late.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E20 — The Prom
Moesha’s date for the proms cancels at the last minute.  She goes unescorted and meets a handsome mysterious boy who disappears at midnight.  She tries to find him, but to no avail.

S2 E16 — Rich Kid
Mary takes a stand against the deadly drug, crack when she discovers that a wealthy and generous new friend of Calvin and Brenda is selling the drug.

S2 E17 — A Matter Of Choice
Lester wins a major contracting bid, which enables the Jenkins' to begin looking for their dream home when Lester discovers that the backers of the construction job are involved in South African investments.

S2 E18 — Happy Twentieth
Plans made by Mary (Marla Gibbs) and Lester (Hal Williams) to celebrate their 20th wedding anniversary result in disharmony when quarreling in-laws come to town.

S2 E19 — Toyland
Guest star Pee Wee Herman plays himself in this special episode in which he, Mary (Marla Gibbs), Lester (Hal Williams) and Sandra (Jackée) are held captive in a toy store and must resort to more than pop guns and bows and arrows to set themselves free.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E18 — The Commercial
A TV commercial inadvertently turns Malcolm McGee's into a gay bar.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E19 — Whole Lotta Love Seat
When Eddie buys a new couch, he doesn't have enough money to pay the rent.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E20 — Swappin'
A mistakenly delivered love letter spawns romantic confusion at McGee's.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E21 — Retreat & Surrender
Malcolm, Eddie and their friends are stranded during their employee picnic and retreat.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E22 — Jingle Fever
After refusing an offer of a buyout, a big tow truck operator destroys Eddie's business.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E10 — The Shoot Out
When Lamont brings home an antique gun, Fred pulls the trigger and is surprised to learn the gun was loaded. Fred has just had an argument with his neighbor Herman Goldstein and the bullet careens through Goldstein's window.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E11 — The Puerto Ricans Are Coming! The Puerto Ricans Are Coming!
Fred is upset because his new neighbor is opening a competing junkyard -- but he's beside himself when he learns the neighbor is Puerto Rican. Fred vows to remedy the situation, over the strong objections of Lamont, who has become Julio's friend.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E12 — A Visit From Lena Horne
Fred spots Lena Horne's car in the parking lot while touring the NBC Studios and sneaks away to meet 'the first lady of his dreams.' When there is no answer to the knock on Lena's dressing room door, Fred enters and inspects her personal belongings.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E13 — Sanford & Son & Sister Makes Three
Fred's old flame Juanita brings her daughter Alice to dinner and it's love at first sight for Lamont. Juanita discloses a very delicate and difficult situation when she tells Fred that Alice is really his daughter -- and Lamont is thus dating his sister.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E14 — Fred & Carol & Fred & Donna
When Fred invites his fiancée Donna and a door-to-door saleslady to dinner on the same evening, Lamont is convulsed by his father's attempts to keep the women apart.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E15 — A Guest In The Yard
Fred and Lamont find a bum in their yard. The Sanfords are jumping to his every whim for fear he'll make good his threat. The uninvited guest claims Fred pushed him -- creating untold injuries -- and he's threatened to sue them for everything they own.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E15 — 984 W. 124th., Apt. 5c
When Louise discovers that George has been sending presents and money to a mysterious address, she follows him to find out why and is shocked...and touched by what she sees.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E16 — George And Whitty
George and Louise are stunned by their landlord Whittendale's plans to evict them, but their biggest surprise is yet to come when they invite him down to discuss it.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E17 — Lionel Gets The Business
George is on cloud nine when he finally persuades Lionel to join him in the family's cleaning business -- until Lionel starts taking him to the cleaners.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E18 — Blackout, The
George blows a fuse when a power blackout hits the city and looters do the same to his store.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E19 — Florence's Union
Florence wants to form a union for maids and succeeds in breaking up the whole household.
